title: Foot Chase on Niagara Falls' East Side Ends with Two in Custody After Guns Recovered - NewsBreak
text:
By Niagara Action ,
2 hours ago
Two people were taken into custody Wednesday afternoon after Niagara Falls police recovered two guns following a foot chase on the city’s East Side.
According to the Niagara Falls Police Department, an officer in the 500 block of 20th Street spotted a person wanted for questioning in connection to a gun-related incident from Tuesday.
Police said the male was walking with another person when the officer attempted to stop them. Instead, both the adult and juvenile ran east toward 21st Street.
Officers noted the juvenile was carrying a backpack while fleeing.
Additional officers responded to the area and later located two males matching the suspects’ descriptions walking in the 2400 block of Ferry Avenue. Police said the backpack was no longer with them.
Both individuals were detained while officers searched the area where the pair allegedly ran.
During the search, police recovered a gun magazine in a backyard. Officers later found two firearms between garages behind a residence in the 500 block of 21st Street.
A crime scene detective responded to collect the weapons.
Police said investigators determined the detained individuals were the same two males who fled from officers and allegedly discarded the firearms during the chase.
Charges against both the adult and juvenile are pending.
The investigation remains ongoing.
